definition.en: A condition in which blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated above the normal range.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A condition in which blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated above the normal range.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: A condition in which blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated above the normal range.

explanation.en: Persistent high blood pressure increases cardiovascular risk and is assessed using repeated blood-pressure measurements and the person’s overall clinical context.

explanation.fa: اطلاعات اصلی این اصطلاح برای مطالعه به شکل ساده ارائه می‌شود.

definition.en: Injury and death of heart muscle caused by a critical reduction in coronary blood flow.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: Injury and death of heart muscle caused by a critical reduction in coronary blood flow.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: Injury and death of heart muscle caused by a critical reduction in coronary blood flow.

explanation.en: A myocardial infarction is a medical emergency commonly caused by sudden blockage of a coronary artery and requires urgent professional care.
explanation.ps: د دې اصطلاح مهم معلومات د زده کړې لپاره په ساده ډول وړاندې کېږي.
explanation.fa: اطلاعات اصلی این اصطلاح برای مطالعه به شکل ساده ارائه می‌شود.

definition.en: An abnormality in the rate or rhythm of the heartbeat.

explanation.en: Arrhythmias range from harmless rhythm variations to conditions that can affect cardiac output and require medical evaluation.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: A clinical syndrome in which the heart is unable to pump or fill sufficiently to meet the body’s needs.

explanation.en: Heart failure can cause shortness of breath, fatigue, and fluid retention and may result from several different cardiac conditions.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: A chronic arterial disease characterized by plaque formation within artery walls.

explanation.en: Atherosclerosis can narrow arteries and increase the risk of coronary artery disease, stroke, and peripheral vascular disease.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: Inflammation of the pericardium, the sac surrounding the heart.

explanation.en: Pericarditis may cause sharp chest pain and can arise from infections, inflammatory disorders, or other causes.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: Inflammation of the inner lining of the heart and heart valves, often caused by infection.

explanation.en: Infective endocarditis can damage heart valves and requires prompt medical diagnosis and treatment.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary

definition.en: Abnormally elevated concentrations of lipids or lipoproteins in the blood.

explanation.en: Hyperlipidemia is an important cardiovascular risk factor and is assessed alongside other health and lifestyle factors.

source: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) MeSH — educational summary
